items.source: If the character encoding for the response has not already been explicitly set via setCharacterEncoding(String) or setContentType(String), the character encoding for the response will be set to the supplied default character encoding.
items.translation: 如果响应字符编码尚未通过setCharacterEncoding(String)或setContentType(String)显式设置，则响应的字符编码将设置为提供的默认字符编码。

items.source: If false, getCharacterEncoding() will return the default character encoding.
items.translation: 如果为false，getCharacterEncoding()将返回默认字符编码。

items.source: Returns a stringified value for Servlet 3.0 compatibility. Consider using getHeaderValue(String) for raw Object access.
items.translation: 返回一个字符串化的值以兼容 Servlet 3.0。请考虑使用getHeaderValue(String)来获取原始 Object 访问。

items.source: Returns a List of stringified values for Servlet 3.0 compatibility. Consider using getHeaderValues(String) for raw Object access.
items.translation: 返回一个字符串化值的列表，以兼容 Servlet 3.0。 建议使用getHeaderValues(String)获取原始对象访问。

items.source: Can be overridden in subclasses, appending a session id or the like in a redirect-specific fashion. For general URL encoding rules, override the common encodeURL(String) method instead, applying to redirect URLs as well as to general URLs.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写，以重定向特定的方式追加会话 ID 或类似内容。对于通用的 URL 编码规则，请重写公共的 encodeURL(String) 方法，该方法同样适用于重定向 URL 和通用 URL。

items.source: If this method is not invoked, ISO-8859-1 will be used as the default character encoding.
items.translation: 如果未调用此方法，将使用 `ISO-8859-1` 作为默认字符编码。

items.source: As of Servlet 3.0, this method is also defined in HttpServletResponse.

items.source: Get the content of the response body as a String, using the provided fallbackCharset if no charset has been explicitly defined and otherwise using the charset specified for the response by the application, either through HttpServletResponse methods or through a charset parameter on the Content-Type.
items.translation: 将响应正文内容作为 `String` 获取，如果未显式定义字符集，则使用提供的 `fallbackCharset`；否则，使用应用程序为响应指定的字符集，该字符集可通过 `HttpServletResponse` 方法或 `Content-Type` 上的字符集参数指定。

items.source: Get the content of the response body as a String, using the charset specified for the response by the application, either through HttpServletResponse methods or through a charset parameter on the Content-Type. If no charset has been explicitly defined, the default character encoding will be used.
items.translation: 将响应正文内容作为 `String` 获取，使用应用程序为响应指定的字符集，该字符集可通过 `HttpServletResponse` 方法或通过 `Content-Type` 上的字符集参数指定。如果未显式定义字符集，则将使用默认字符编码。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to encodeURL(String), returning the given URL String as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给encodeURL(String)，原样返回给定的 URL 字符串。
